_comment: Role-specific content. Public sources only: the job posting (LinkedIn 4476338211, via ambi.scout) and leva.pe, both read 2026-10-19.
question: Why hire Alexey as LEVA's Product Architect?
answer: Turned legal and financial contract terms into software that shipped in seven months.
Knows from nine years inside UBS which regulatory requirements shape a product.
Builds with AI agents today, under tests and controls. This page is one example.

company_context.what: Co-investment syndication infrastructure: deal managers set up a vehicle, invite their investor network, collect commitments, close, and administer the portfolio to exit.
company_context.structure: A contractual partnership without legal personality instead of an SPV; the deal manager holds the shares for the syndicate; a cantonal tax ruling confirms the partnership is not a taxable subject.
company_context.regulation: Member of the VQF self-regulatory organisation (anti-money-laundering supervision recognised by FINMA).
company_context.scale_public: 4,000+ users, 450+ deals, 140+ managing partners, 40+ countries (leva.pe, October 2026).

role_context.summary: Product-first role: set the roadmap, decide build, buy, partner or not build, hold financial, legal and regulatory complexity (securities, KYC/AML/KYT) and turn it into simple products, redesign processes rather than digitise them, and prototype and build meaningful parts with AI coding and agentic tools. Works alongside a Financial Systems Engineer.

requirements.text: 5+ years in product management, product architecture or a technical product role
Co-designed, built and shipped a regulated financial product
Understanding of financial products and securities; compliance and legal requirements as product workflows
Hands-on with AI-assisted development: research, prototype, code and test
Comfort with ambiguity; break a vision into shippable steps
Private markets, tokenisation or on-chain settlement (advantage)

presets.title: Co-investor voting
presets.why: Listed as in development on leva.pe.
presets.brief: Let co-investors in a syndicate vote digitally on deal-manager proposals (follow-on, exit, consent items), with quorum and majority rules from the Partnership Agreement and a legally usable record.

presets.title: KYT transaction monitoring
presets.why: The job spec names KYC/AML/KYT as product flows.
presets.brief: Monitor capital inflows and distributions for AML red flags, route alerts to the compliance analyst with evidence, and keep an audit trail the VQF auditor accepts.

presets.title: EU jurisdiction expansion
presets.why: The job spec mentions expanding licences across jurisdictions.
presets.brief: Make the partnership model and onboarding work for an EU jurisdiction: legal structure, tax treatment, licence requirements and product changes.

presets.title: Tokenised syndicate units
presets.why: The job spec calls tokenisation and on-chain settlement a strong plus.
presets.brief: Represent co-investors' economic rights as DLT-based securities, with transfer rules for secondaries and settlement on-chain.

presets.title: AI term-sheet intake
presets.why: Legal structuring is automated today; deal terms still arrive as documents.
presets.brief: Read an uploaded term sheet or CLA, propose structured deal terms with the source sentence for each, let the deal manager confirm, and feed the existing structuring flow.
